title: Multi-view fnirs identifies neurophysiological subtypes in post-stroke aphasia
abstract: arXiv:2611.34169v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Post-stroke aphasia is clinically heterogeneous, and conventional classifications may not capture differences in brain functional organisation. We tested whether resting-state and task-based functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) could identify neurophysiological subgroups alongside clinical assessment.Seventy-nine patients underwent unsupervised clustering using three fNIRS feature views: resting-state activity and connectivity, language-task activation, and rest-to-task connectivity reconfiguration. Similarity network fusion and spectral clustering integrated the views. Clinical and behavioural measures were excluded from clustering.Three clusters (n = 32, 17 and 30) were identified. This solution had the largest eigengap and was the only candidate significant after permutation testing and Holm correction (adjusted P = 0.001). translated_title: 多视图fNIRS识别卒中后失语症的神经生理学亚型
translated_abstract: 卒中后失语症在临床上具有高度异质性，传统的分类方法可能无法反映大脑功能组织的差异。我们检验了静息态与任务态功能近红外光谱（fNIRS）结合临床评估能否识别神经生理学亚组。79名患者接受无监督聚类分析，采用三种fNIRS特征视图：静息态活动与连接性、语言任务激活，以及静息态到任务态的连接重构。研究采用相似性网络融合和谱聚类来整合各视图，且临床和行为学指标被排除在聚类过程之外。最终识别出三个聚类（人数分别为32、17和30）。该方案具有最大的特征间隙，并且是经过置换检验和Holm校正后唯一显著的候选方案（校正后P = 0.001）。该方案在子采样条件下保持稳定（平均调整兰德指数为0.773），但当t
tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于相似性网络融合与谱聚类的多视图fNIRS无监督聚类方法，在不依赖临床和行为学指标的情况下，仅利用脑功能数据将卒中后失语症患者成功划分为三个稳定的神经生理学亚型。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a multi-view fNIRS unsupervised clustering approach combining similarity network fusion and spectral clustering, which identifies three stable neurophysiological subtypes in post-stroke aphasia using brain function data alone, without relying on clinical or behavioural measures.
